title: Red Team, Then Blue Team
scenario: A toy vulnerable app has several believable weaknesses. Investigate each one, choose the only viable path, then switch sides and apply the right fix.

environmentData.learnBody: A good defense targets the actual root cause. The right patch closes the specific weakness while keeping the application working; a random fix is not automatically useful.

steps.context: Investigate the fake app: which weakness is viable end-to-end?

options.label: Exposed debug page
options.feedback: Dead end: the page contains no data access.

options.label: Anonymous file share
options.response: Clue confirmed: the share exposes the training data.

options.label: Fancy dashboard color
options.feedback: Dead end: appearance is not an exploitable weakness.

steps.context: Choose the next red-team action for the anonymous share.

options.label: Browse the shared files
options.response: The file listing appears in the toy app.

options.label: Guess a real password
options.feedback: No password guessing is needed for this scripted share.

options.label: Delete the dashboard
options.feedback: That does not access the training data.

options.label: Extract the training record
options.response: Training record captured. First flag earned.

options.label: Install an exploit
options.feedback: No exploit code is used in this safe simulation.

steps.context: Now defend: identify the real weakness you learned about.

options.label: Disable every login forever
options.feedback: That breaks the app and does not address the share.

options.label: Change the dashboard colors
options.feedback: Cosmetic changes do not close the weakness.

steps.context: Pick the fix that closes the hole without breaking the app.

options.label: Add a second logo
options.feedback: A logo does not change access control.

options.label: Delete all application data
options.feedback: Destroying data is not a safe patch.

options.label: Run the safe re-test
options.response: The scripted re-attack bounces off the patched share.

options.label: Ignore the result
options.feedback: A fix should always be re-tested.
